To find the root of $f(x)$, we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
{log}_{2}⁡(4-2x)+1=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{2}⁡(4-2x)+1 & =0 \\ {log}_{2}⁡(4-2x) & =-1 \\ {2}^{{log}_{2}⁡(4-2x)} & ={2}^{-1} \\ 4-2x & =\frac{1}{2} \\ -2x & =-\frac{7}{2} \\ x & =\frac{7}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=\frac{7}{4}.$
